settings.heading: Built for the one who wears different colours.
settings.text: A3GK exists because keepers are an afterthought at most football shops. We sell a small range, only for keepers, and only things we'd use ourselves.

settings.title: If it isn't good enough to recommend, we don't sell it.
settings.text: Every product is sampled and used before it goes on sale. Plenty don't make it.

settings.title: Our own brand where we can beat the big names fairly.
settings.text: Glove care, tape and socks: the things you buy again and again. We have them made to our spec by manufacturers we've tested, and price them for repeat buying — not for margin.

settings.title: Every product page says who it isn't for.
settings.text: A grip spray that's great on grass might be wrong for indoor floors. We say so.

settings.title: Prices that don't move.
settings.text: No sales that are always on. Bundle savings are worked out from the current price of each item.

settings.title: Real lead times.
settings.text: Custom kit shows its delivery date before you pay, and we plan to hit it.

settings.heading: One day, our own gloves.
settings.text: When we find a manufacturer who can actually do them right — pro-level latex, cut and stitching, tested side by side against the gloves serious keepers already wear. Not before. It might take a year or more, and we're fine with that.
